audio-a2-u2-l1-a01.transcript: Last weekend, I was in Najaf with my cousins. The streets were busy, but the visit was memorable.

audio-a2-u2-l1-a04.transcript: Rita was at a family party yesterday. Her parents were there too.

audio-a2-u2-l2-a01.transcript: We arrived early, visited the castle and decided to eat near the river.

audio-a2-u2-l2-a04.transcript: Ali planned a picnic, packed lunch and walked to the park. Rain started at noon.

audio-a2-u2-l4-a01.transcript: A: How was the concert? B: Great. A: Who did you go with? B: My sister. We didn't stay for the last song.

audio-a2-u2-l4-a04.transcript: A: What happened yesterday? B: I missed the bus. A: Did you arrive late? B: No, I took a taxi.

audio-a2-u2-l7-a02.transcript: First we visited the market. Then we ate by the river. Suddenly it rained, so we ran into a small café.
